title: poa arctica var. stricta
intro: Poa arctica var. stricta, commonly known as Arctic Bluegrass, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae and is native to the Arctic tundra regions. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Poa arctica var. stricta include reducing inflammation, soothing wounds, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
